name: death_back
prompts: A person standing is thrown backward, staggers two steps back with the arms flung forward, the knees give way and the body falls flat onto the back and lies still

name: death_forward
prompts: A person standing doubles over at the waist, drops onto both knees, then topples forward onto the face and lies still

name: death_crumple
prompts: A person standing goes limp all at once, the knees buckle and the body drops straight down in a heap onto the floor and lies still

name: death_spin
prompts: A person standing twists hard to the right as the right shoulder is jerked back, stumbles sideways and falls onto the right side and lies still
